features.name: Send and sign documents
features.summary: Upload a PDF, place fields, send it to signers by email and get back a sealed, signed copy.

features.name: Signed PDFs that match what you saw
features.summary: Field values land exactly where the signer placed them, even on pages with offset or rotated boxes.

features.name: Connect the TDPdf desktop app
features.summary: Sign in from the browser to link TDPdf to your account, with no token to copy and paste.

features.name: Signing keys held in Azure Key Vault
features.summary: Operators can keep the signing key in Azure Key Vault so it never sits on the server.

scenarios.name: Send a contract from TDPdf and collect signatures
